mapper.sql: SELECT m.id AS id, m.member_no AS memberNo, m.name AS name, m.phone AS phone, ml.name AS levelName, m.points AS points, m.total_consume AS totalConsume, m.consume_times AS consumeTimes, m.last_consume_time AS lastConsumeTime, m.register_time AS registerTime, m.birthday AS birthday, NULL AS bizDate, NULL AS newCount, NULL AS cumulativeCount, NULL AS memberCount, NULL AS sleepingDays FROM member m JOIN member_level ml ON ml.id = m.level_id
mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS id, NULL AS memberNo, NULL AS name, NULL AS phone, NULL AS levelName, NULL AS points, NULL AS totalConsume, NULL AS consumeTimes, NULL AS lastConsumeTime, NULL AS registerTime, NULL AS birthday, DATE(m.register_time) AS bizDate, COUNT(*) AS newCount, NULL AS cumulativeCount, NULL AS memberCount, NULL AS sleepingDays FROM member m WHERE m.register_time >= #{beginTime} AND m.register_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(m.register_time) ORDER BY bizDate
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE register_time < #{before}

SELECT ml.id AS id, NULL AS memberNo, NULL AS name, NULL AS phone, ml.name AS levelName, NULL AS points, NULL AS totalConsume, NULL AS consumeTimes, NULL AS lastConsumeTime, NULL AS registerTime, NULL AS birthday, NULL AS bizDate, NULL AS newCount, NULL AS cumulativeCount, COUNT(m.id) AS memberCount, NULL AS sleepingDays FROM member_level ml LEFT JOIN member m ON m.level_id = ml.id AND m.status = 1 WHERE ml.status = 1 GROUP BY ml.id, ml.name ORDER BY ml.sort_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m WHERE m.status = 1 AND COALESCE(m.last_consume_time, m.register_time) < #{deadline}

WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.birthday IS NOT NULL
AND (DAYOFYEAR(m.birthday) - DAYOFYEAR(CURDATE()) + 365) % 365 <= 7 ORDER BY (DAYOFYEAR(m.birthday) - DAYOFYEAR(CURDATE()) + 365) % 365, m.id
AND MONTH(m.birthday) = MONTH(CURDATE()) ORDER BY DAY(m.birthday), m.id
LIMIT #{limit}
